messages:
marc: hi all — back from military leave next month (returning 2026-11-01). my spouse was on COBRA the whole time and now can enroll on our plan. open enrollment closed. is this a QLE for adding spouse? what do you need for proof and will coverage be retroactive to my return date? also worried about COBRA termination notices and payroll deductions.

Ivy (People Ops): welcome back, marc 44f yes, return from active duty that changes dependent coverage usually qualifies as a QLE (gain of employer coverage). we'll need: 1) your military leave orders showing active duty dates, 2) spouse's COBRA or alternate coverage end confirmation, and 3) marriage certificate (if not already on file). please upload to the portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/upload and choose "QLE - Return from Military / Gain of Coverage" within 30 days of your return.

marc: uploaded orders_20260501_20261101.pdf and spouse_cobra_end_oct2026.pdf. can we make coverage effective 11/1? spouse's COBRA technically ends 10/31 so no overlap needed.

Dana (Benefits): got the docs. we can set the spouse's effective date to 11/01/2026 to line up with your return. medical/dental/vision will be active 11/01 and digital ID cards available within 48 hours. physical cards ~7-10 business days.

marc: and COBRA? do they need to elect anything or will vendor auto-cancel? any notices I should expect from our COBRA admin?

Dana (Benefits): once we post the dependent enrollment, we send a termination message to the COBRA vendor with the end date (10/31). spouse should get a final notice from COBRA admin confirming cancellation; we recommend they keep that for records. if the spouse already paid a month ahead for Nov, COBRA may refund or process a short-term credit. we'll coordinate with Payroll on refund.

Victor (Payroll): payroll note: if premiums were deducted for Nov on the last payday, Payroll will issue a retro refund on the next paycheck after benefits posts the change. if the refund is >$400 we can split it per preference. also confirm if you want the medical premium adjustment collected or credited to your next net pay.

marc: prefer a single refund if it's small. also i was on the company HDHP with HSA contributions pre-leave; adding spouse moves me to family tier. does that affect my HSA mid-year?

Dana (Benefits): yes — HSA contribution limits depend on coverage tier. moving to family on 11/01 means IRS pro-rata rules apply. you can contribute family max only if you meet the testing period rules for the rest of the year; otherwise your max will be prorated. we'll send a month-by-month cap and an HSA election update form.

marc: any state-specific COBRA issues? spouse lives in another state (VA) while I was deployed but moving back to CA with me.

LegalBot: note: COBRA is federal but state continuation laws vary. Virginia has its own mini-COBRA rules that may extend coverage; California may have different notification timing. Benefits will handle vendor notices but retain copies for audit. If theref27s a state mismatch, we may need the spousef27s prior address and the COBRA admin contact to reconcile.

Ivy (People Ops): next steps: Benefits to post enrollment effective 11/01 (Dana), Payroll to compute any refund/adjustments (Victor), and People Ops will confirm COBRA termination notice copy. Target ETA 3 business days. cc @Victor @Dana.

Dana (Benefits): posted enrollment; spouse added effective 2026-11-01. you'll get confirmation email and digital ID link.

Victor (Payroll): computed refund: $112.34 (Nov medical premium collected). will refund on 11/20 payroll. if you want it split, DM me.

marc: perfect, thanks everyone. one tiny follow-up f4dd will the spouse need to re-enroll in dependent-care or life insurance separately?

Dana (Benefits): dependent-care FSA is tied to eligible dependents for claims; adding a spouse doesn't change DC-FSA unless you designated them as dependent. for life insurance, spouse must be added to beneficiary/coverage elections; we'll send a short enrollment packet if you want spousal life coverage.

Ivy (People Ops): closing loop: confirmation email sent and Payroll refund scheduled. welcome home, marc. :us_afghanistan:
